trigger_condition.state_trigger: Autograd is enabled and a module has a full backward hook registered.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Forward pass through a module where the hooked output is consumed by an in-place operation.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Use nn.ReLU(inplace=True) after a module with register_full_backward_hook; input tensors require gradients.

bug_oracle.description: RuntimeError: Output 0 of BackwardHookFunctionBackward is a view and is being modified inplace. This view was created inside a custom Function and the autograd logic to handle view+inplace would override the custom backward associated with the custom Function.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Replace activations with in-place variants such as ReLU(inplace=True), LeakyReLU(inplace=True), or other in-place operations.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create input tensors with requires_grad=True to keep autograd view tracking active.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Register full backward hooks on modules whose outputs will be passed to in-place operations.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Build sequential models where a full backward hook is registered on module k and module k+1 performs an in-place operation on that output, then run the forward pass under grad mode.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Catch RuntimeError messages indicating that a view created inside a custom Function is being modified inplace.
